subject.title: PR Limit Update: Why We Now Cap at 20 Open PRs Per Author

question: Should this pinned PR-limit policy announcement remain open as the public notice, or should CONTRIBUTING.md and the shipped automation now be treated as the canonical policy surface?
rationale: The source policy is already implemented, but the issue has a later maintainer reopen/repin signal, so automation cannot safely infer whether the open issue is intentionally serving as an announcement.

options.title: Keep pinned notice
options.body: Leave this issue open, locked, and pinned as the public queue-policy announcement while source docs and automation continue to match it.

options.title: Make docs canonical
options.body: Unpin and close this issue with a short note pointing to CONTRIBUTING.md and the shipped 20-PR automation as the canonical policy.

options.title: Revise the policy
options.body: Change the threshold or exception policy in CONTRIBUTING.md, `.github/workflows/labeler.yml`, and `scripts/github/barnacle-auto-response.mjs` together.

recommendation.title: Keep pinned notice
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open, locked, and pinned as the public queue-policy announcement while source docs and automation continue to match it.

likelyOwner.reason: They provided the latest explicit maintainer/admin signal by renaming, repinning, and reopening this policy notice.
